title: Agent Failure Modes
motto: MASFT (Berkeley, 2025) catalogs 14 multi-agent failure modes in 3 categories. Microsoft's Taxonomy documents how existing AI failures amplify in agentic settings. Industry field data converges on five recurring modes: hallucinated actions, scope creep, cascading errors, context loss, tool misuse.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Teams ship agents that work on 90% of traces. The 10% failures are not random noise — they fall into a small number of recurring categories. Once you can name them, you can monitor for them and fix them.
